name: roots-mjs
description: The dev tool roots roots.mjs and its Jet twin orchestrator/Roots.jet (#5072 c9): a root is the environment's value, else the default derived from $HOME and the XDG directories. Imported, roots.mjs gives node tools the roots; run with root names, it prints `NAME=value` for each, as Roots.jet does, and exits 64 at a name that is not a root. roots.mjs does not read the machine's jet/env file, which Roots.jet and roots.sh do, so every case points XDG_CONFIG_HOME at a directory without one (entry roots-sh covers the file). Every case sets every root (empty is unset, as all three programs read it) so the machine's own leak into nothing, and the XDG data and config directories are relative so no path names the machine. XDG_CACHE_HOME stays the machine's, because the harness starts both programs through Tools/agent/JetEnv.jet, which keeps its dev shells there; roots-sh's check.jet writes the machine's cache directory as `$XDG_CACHE_HOME`. The cases cover the defaults, the environment over the defaults (JET_BIN, the jet under test, included), a name that is not a root after one that is, and no name.
